evidence.application: Candidate HTML, CSS, forest module, monthly controller and wallet bridge are served without local overlays.
evidence.wallet: A synthetic Wallet Standard provider exposes two fabricated addresses and message signatures; on-chain methods throw.
evidence.payment: Only /assets/arcade/arcade-recovery-wallet.js is replaced with a synthetic approval/rejection adapter. It never calls a wallet or network.
evidence.network: All API requests are mocked. Every unrecognized write is aborted. No API write or payment is forwarded.
evidence.clock: Playwright Clock and matching HTTP Date response headers exercise UTC transitions; forest DOM is only observed.
